//: The TypeScript project for the whole repo. Type-checking is global, like linting: `yarn typecheck` runs once over every package. Editors resolve this file for any .ts/.tsx source, since packages carry no tsconfig.json of their own.
Declaration emit is separate: it is per package, because each package publishes its own types. See scripts/build-types.js, which reads the compiler options from this file so they cannot drift.
